changelog: **Double-booking guard (#1995):** every write path that puts a meeting on a calendar (`POST /api/meetings`, a move or new length via `PATCH /api/meetings/[id]`, `POST /api/meeting-requests` and accepting one) now refuses an hour either participant already has, with `409 { code: 'conflict', conflictsWith: { title, startsAt } }`. Busy windows (`src/lib/busyWindows.ts`) are read from non-cancelled `Meeting` rows (cut short at `endedAt`) plus the expanded occurrences of active `MeetingSeries`, using each row's own duration. The arithmetic is half-open and pure (`src/lib/busyWindowsRule.ts`, unit-tested), so back-to-back meetings are not a clash. Check and insert run in one transaction behind a `SELECT … FOR UPDATE` on the participants' `User` rows: three simultaneous bookings of one hour yield one meeting and two 409s. A bulk schedule books the free pairs and returns the rest in `conflicts`. `force: true` (an admin or the pair's mentor) books over a clash on purpose and writes a `meeting.forceConflict` audit row. The conflicting meeting's title is withheld from a caller who takes no part in it. `/api/availability?mentorId=` returns the booked hours as bare `busy` windows to an admin or the paired mentee, and the portal's slot picker stops offering them.

en: Nobody gets double-booked any more: a meeting can't be scheduled, moved or requested into an hour that's already taken, and you see what's in the way. Booked hours no longer appear among the times you can request.
tr: Artık kimseye aynı saate iki toplantı konmuyor: dolu bir saate toplantı planlanamıyor, taşınamıyor ya da talep edilemiyor ve neyle çakıştığı gösteriliyor. Dolu saatler artık talep edebileceğin saatler arasında görünmüyor.
de: Niemand wird mehr doppelt gebucht: In eine bereits belegte Stunde lässt sich kein Meeting mehr planen, verschieben oder anfragen, und du siehst, was im Weg ist. Belegte Zeiten erscheinen nicht mehr unter den Zeiten, die du anfragen kannst.
